comments.body:
This worked for me on Ubuntu: FF, Chrome and Opera.

Scott Prater, are you in a position to pull down this PR, build it, and test?

Assuming this works for Scott Prater as well.

I am wondering if we should go through the common.js and make the implementation of jQuery.ajax consistent.

Some cases use error: (https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo4/blob/fcrepo-1981/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/views/common.js#L214) others use .fail() (https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo4/blob/fcrepo-1981/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/views/common.js#L242)

Most everyone does a return false; but in at least one instance the (as I understand it) more correct event.preventDefault(); is also used (https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo4/blob/fcrepo-1981/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/views/common.js#L173)
To minimize scope creep into the 4.5.1-RC branch, could you please create a new ticket for your follow-on updates, Jared Whiklo?
I pulled the commit from Jared Whiklo's fcrepo4 repo, applied the change, and tested on Firefox on Windows, Linux, and Mac. All the versioning tests (and other manual tests) now pass.
